summary.headline: Planetary Foundations by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Astrological judgments for superior and inferior planets, distinguishing evening and morning indications in each zodiac sign from Taurus through Aquarius, including weather, health, rulers, agriculture, property, and social affairs. Hermes is cited for assigning superior planets to the third and middle of the twelve signs.
